key_insight: Molmo2 provides openly released model weights and training data to deliver a competitive video-language model that supports video understanding and explicit grounding, closing the gap between proprietary VLMs and the open-source community.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the lack of transparent, high-quality open-weight video-language models and datasets—many strong VLMs are proprietary or distilled from proprietary systems, and grounding capabilities (spatial/temporal localization) are under-supported in open releases.
method: Release of model weights and an accompanying transparent training dataset/recipe focused on video and image language alignment.
Train a unified multimodal model that integrates temporal video features with language and incorporates grounding objectives to map text to spatial/temporal regions.
Benchmark the model on video understanding and grounding tasks to validate open reproducibility and competitive performance.
impact: Molmo2 enables researchers and practitioners to reproduce, extend, and fine-tune a foundation video-language model with grounding capability without relying on proprietary data or distilled models—accelerating open research and practical grounded multimodal applications.
visual_elements: Architecture diagram: multimodal transformer showing video frames + text inputs → grounding outputs
Dataset composition chart: sources, scale (images vs. videos), and annotation types (temporal labels, spatial boxes)
Example grounding panels: video frame(s) with highlighted bounding boxes/segments linked to descriptive captions
Benchmark comparison bar chart: Molmo2 vs. proprietary and other open models on video understanding and grounding metrics
paper_title: Molmo2: Open Weights and Data for Vision-Language Models with Video Understanding and Grounding
paper_authors: Christopher Clark, Jieyu Zhang, Zixian Ma, Jae Sung Park, Mohammadreza Salehi
